name: Kato Unitrack (HO)
description: Kato Unitrack HO is a metric, integrated-roadbed HO-scale system using code 83 rail. Lengths are encoded in the part name in millimeters (e.g. S246 = 246 mm straight, R550-22.5 = 550 mm radius / 22.5-deg arc curve). Track centers are 64 mm. Product codes are of the form '2-xxx'. The HO line is smaller than the N line; double-track straights, easement curves, and the very tight (R150/R216) tram radii do not exist in HO.

pieces.label: S62 straight (62 mm)

data_quality_note: Generated 2026-05-05 by an agent without working WebFetch/WebSearch access. Geometry math (length_mm = in*25.4; curve length = 2*pi*r*deg/360) is hand-computed and high-confidence. Product codes (SKUs) and source_url values are derived from training-data recall and were NOT live-verified. source_verified_at is null on every piece until a session with web access re-checks the catalog. See docs/library-notes/kato-unitrack-ho.md for per-system caveats.
